name: Walnut Creek Marina & Campground
note: Campground beside Walnut Creek Marina on Barren River Lake, run by the concessionaire Bright Sky Campgrounds. A new section of gravel back-in sites opened in 2026 next to an older section of seasonal sites, on a wooded ridge about 40 m above the lake's summer pool; the marina, restaurant and boat ramp are down the hill. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: brightskycampgrounds.com (read 2026-11-24): 'A brand-new section at Walnut Creek Marina featuring approximately 50 full-hookup sites ... Now open for nightly reservations, with the existing seasonal section operating adjacent'; Campspot park 5984 (API read 2026-11-24 via headless browser after a CloudFront 403): 55 'Standard RV Site' back-in gravel sites, 30/50A + water, rvLengthMax 50 ft, Motorhome allowed, open Apr 1-Nov 29 2027, one night bookable on weeknights, Saturdays and Memorial Day weekend (no minimum); verified Campspot stays Aug/Oct/Nov 2026. On Corps of Engineers Barren River Lake project land (corpslakes.erdc.dren.mil H200970 lists Walnut Creek as an area 'Managed by Others'), so ownership federal like Bright Sky's other three Corps concessions. Price gate: $35/night base (2 adults, before tax) every date read Apr-Nov 2027, $40 holiday weekends - passes $50 without a gateway (none within 40 km). Google 'Walnut Creek Campground' 4.5 (24); the marina listing 4.5 (70) is shared with the marina/restaurant. Long-stay: seasonal section beside it ($2,000 season Apr 1-Nov 30 by application, barrenrivermarinas.com/walnut-creek-marina), but the ~55 nightly sites are the larger share (RV Life lists 33 sites for the older section).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-24: Campspot site map (operator per-site map, read 2026-11-24) draws one long N-S loop from the toll house up a ridge toward a cove at the north end; KyFromAbove Phase 3 3-in leaf-off imagery (kyraster.ky.gov, predates the 2026 section; Esri's newest capture is 2021) shows the camping strip/meadow at 36.8121,-86.0766 to 36.8142,-86.0752 with ~110 m of continuous woods between the north end of the meadow and the cove's high-water tree line (~36.8153). Open-Meteo DEM: pads 204-215 m vs Barren River Lake summer pool 552 ft (168 m) - a ridge 35-45 m above the lake, a climb-down not a walk-across. The 12 Campspot site photos (new gravel pads, cut red-clay banks, fences, tree lines) show no water from any pad. Campspot tags A01, C26, C27, C30, C31 'Waterfront Site' and Bright Sky says 'along Barren River Lake' - marketing/tags with no qualifying confirmation; default down. No view confirmed either.

fees.note: One night for 2 adults before tax on Campspot: $35 on every weeknight and Saturday read (April-November 2027), $40 on Memorial Day and July 4 weekends. Campspot adds its own $3 booking fee.

fees_source: Campspot API for park 5984 (www.campspot.com/book/walnut-creek-marina-and-campground), read 2026-11-24: Standard RV Site base 35.00 + Campspot booking fee 3.00 (avg 38.00) on 2027-05-04/05-08/06-08/06-12/09-14/09-18 and 2026-11-24/11-28; avg 43.00 on 2027-05-29 and 2027-07-03; guests0,2,0 (2 adults).

booking.note: Booked on Campspot by the concessionaire Bright Sky Campgrounds; seasonal sites by application or phone, (270) 938-3715.

booking_source: Campspot API read 2026-11-24: 2027-11-27 refused 'Cannot book more than 365 days in advance'; brightskycampgrounds.com 'For seasonal bookings, call (270) 938-3715'; barrenrivermarinas.com/walnut-creek-marina 'Apply online' for seasonal sites.

discounts.note: 10% off with promo codes for military, seniors 62+ and visitors with disabilities (Campspot).

sites.note: 55 nightly back-in gravel sites on Campspot for 2027, all water and 30/50A electric; the older seasonal section is separate.

sites_source: Campspot availability API, park 5984, type 58683 'Standard RV Site', 55 campsites (A01-A22, B23-B59, C01-C31 partial), read 2026-11-24.
hookups_source: Campspot site amenities (every site: '30-Amp', '50-Amp', 'Electricity', 'Water Hook-Up'), read 2026-11-24; brightskycampgrounds.com FAQ: 'Electric/water sites include a 30/50-amp electrical pedestal and a water spigot.'
facilities_source: brightskycampgrounds.com (read 2026-11-24), Walnut Creek card: 'Amenities Bathhouse with showers Laundry facility Dump station Marina access'.
season_source: Campspot API read 2026-11-24: 2026-11-29 open, 2026-11-30 to 2027-03-31 'Site is closed for your dates' / RESORT_CLOSED_RULE, 2027-04-01 open; barrenrivermarinas.com/walnut-creek-marina: seasonal RV sites 'April 1 to November 30'.
flags: Ownership: federal chosen because the Corps' Barren River Lake page lists Walnut Creek as an area 'Managed by Others' and the operator runs the Corps concessions 1570-1572; but RV Life types it 'county', an old Corps page said Allen and Barren County fiscal courts lease Walnut Creek, and TheDyrt calls the campground privately owned. If the county still holds the lease and sublets, 'local' may be the better class.
Sewer left out of hookups: Bright Sky says ~10 sites have sewer, barrenrivermarinas.com says 'All sites include full hookups (water, electric, sewer)', Campspot lists no sewer on any site.

Waterfront re-audit lead: Campspot tags A01, C26, C27, C30, C31 'Waterfront Site'; the 2026 section postdates every image available (Esri 2021, KyFromAbove Phase 3). Re-check when newer imagery shows the new loops; on the DEM the whole ridge is 35-45 m above summer pool, so a view is the most it could earn.
Pin placed on the camping strip (Campspot's own point is on the marina docks at 36.8130,-86.0724; Google's 'Walnut Creek Campground' pin is at 36.8110,-86.0772 near the entrance).
Campspot listed 81-84 sites for late 2026 but 55 for 2027 - the extra 2026 sites were likely seasonal sites released for the shoulder season.
